question.text: Under SEBI's Stewardship Code for AIFs (Circular dated December 24, 2019), AIFs shall mandatorily follow a Stewardship Code in relation to their investment in:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (page 88) and SEBI Circular CIR/CFD/CMD1/168/2019 dated December 24, 2019, all AIFs shall mandatorily follow a Stewardship Code in relation to their investment in listed equity securities. The Code covers voting and engagement with listed investee companies. The Trap: Government securities, unlisted debt, and LRS-based foreign holdings are not within the scope set by the SEBI circular for AIF stewardship obligations. Note: The footnote on page 88 cites SEBI Circular CIR/CFD/CMD1/168/2019 dated December 24, 2019; the listed-equity scope is stated directly in that paragraph.
